title: rnel: Refined Neutrosophic Evidential Logic
description: A Python library for evidential reasoning that keeps contradiction, ignorance and retracted evidence apart. It implements Refined Neutrosophic Evidential Logic (RNEL) evidence tuples, Subjective Logic opinions and operators, priority-product and base-rate-calibrated operators, ranking cascades, decision policies, zero-shot RNEL from text via NLI, neural evidential heads (PyTorch) and an experimental signed-evidence ledger. The core uses only the Python standard library. Academic, experimental software; the API may change.
